title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard view without an Agent 365 licence
summary: Hold: the default-state field says the licence-free view arrives automatically, but the briefing itself correctly says Microsoft has not stated that. The roadmap facts and documented dashboard controls are supported; the control paths and checklist also need small completeness corrections.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes viewing the Agent 365 Dashboard in Viva Insights without an Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; licensing.notes; controls[0].note
claims.claim: Learn marks the Agent Dashboard as preview.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard has Copilot Agent Dashboard and Agent 365 Dashboard views.
claims.quote: It includes two different reporting experiences or views:

claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard reports agent adoption and associated Copilot Credit usage.
claims.quote: Copilot Agent Dashboard - Provides leaders and analysts with actionable insights into agent adoption and associated Copilot Credit usage

claims.claim: That Copilot Credit usage measures agent use by employees without Microsoft Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Copilot Credit usage, which measures how agents are used by employees who don't have Microsoft Copilot licenses.

claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard view covers agents used within Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: This view of the dashboard provides insights only for agents used within Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: The Agent 365 Dashboard reports adoption and sessions for all supported agents across Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard – Provides leaders and analysts with actionable insights into agent adoption and sessions, on all supported agents used across Microsoft 365 apps.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Selecting All agents at the top right switches to the Agent 365 Dashboard.
claims.quote: At the top right, select All agents to view the Agent 365 Dashboard. Clear All Agents to view the Copilot Agent Dashboard.

claims.claim: Reported agents may be built in Copilot Studio, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
claims.quote: Built in Microsoft Copilot Studio, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit

claims.claim: Reported agents may come from end users, organisational publication, Microsoft or third parties.
claims.quote: Built by end users, formally published by your organization, and created by Microsoft or third parties

claims.claim: Active agents are broken down into User, Your org, Microsoft and Third party creator types.
claims.quote: This section helps you understand who is creating the agents used in your organization. It shows the total number of active agents, along with a breakdown of active agents by creator type.

claims.claim: The dashboard shows which user-built agents are shared.
claims.quote: On the User creator type, you can also see how many user-built agents are shared. Shared agents shows the number and percentage of user-created agents that have more than one user.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page currently requires at least 50 assigned Microsoft Copilot licences for the Copilot Agent view.
claims.quote: Copilot Agent Dashboard: Your organization must have at least 50 Microsoft Copilot licenses assigned and have agent activity.

claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard licensing prerequisites also require agent activity.
claims.quote: Your organization must have at least 50 Microsoft Copilot licenses assigned and have agent activity.

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Learn currently adds Agent 365 licensing to the Copilot Agent Dashboard requirements for the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard: The same licensing requirements as the Copilot Agent Dashboard view, plus Agent 365 licensing.

claims.claim: Learn says the All agents toggle does not appear when the Agent 365 licensing requirement is unmet.
claims.quote: If your organization doesn't meet this requirement, the All agents toggle won't appear in the dashboard.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn has not yet documented the roadmap's removal of the Agent 365 licence requirement.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" "without an Agent 365 license"; opened Agent Dashboard and Copilot Dashboard licensing pages. Results still require Agent 365 licensing and do not document the roadmap waiver.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Whether the 50-Copilot-licence requirement continues after the planned waiver is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" "50" license requirements; "Agent 365 Dashboard" "without" "license" licensing 50 automatic access terms of use. Read Agent Dashboard and Copilot Dashboard prerequisites; neither specifies post-waiver requirements.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the newly licence-free Agent 365 view automatically appears for existing eligible viewers.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" "automatically" licensing; "Agent 365 Dashboard" enable disable switch license change automatic. Read Agent Dashboard access rules and manage-settings page; these describe existing access, not automatic arrival after the waiver.

claims.claim: The existing Agent Dashboard is on by default as part of the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard is on by default as part of the Viva Insights web app.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The change's defaultState is on, meaning the newly licence-free Agent 365 view reaches eligible viewers without admin action.
claims.quote: defaultState: "on"; "Microsoft has not stated whether the unlicensed Agent 365 view appears for those people automatically on arrival"
claims.fix: Set defaultState to "unknown". Keep the existing Agent Dashboard's documented default separate from this change. Replace the risk rationale with: "Medium. Existing Agent Dashboard controls cover access, but Microsoft has not stated whether the newly licence-free Agent 365 view appears automatically; plan who should see its agent and creator reporting."

claims.claim: Automatic access uses Microsoft Entra ID's manager hierarchy.
claims.quote: Access is based on Microsoft Entra ID Data, specifically the manager hierarchy attribute.

claims.claim: Tenant qualification for hierarchy-based automatic access requires at least 2,500 Entra ID users.
claims.quote: The tenant has at least 2,500 users with an Entra ID

claims.claim: Tenant qualification also requires a majority of users in one reporting line.
claims.quote: The majority of users in the tenant are part of a single reporting line; for example, they report to the same CEO

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Qualifying senior leaders receive automatic access rather than access being granted to all users.
claims.quote: The user's in the top three levels in the organization. The user has a significant portion of the organization in their reporting line.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope
claims.claim: Users assigned the Global administrator role also receive dashboard access, subject to the stated PIM caveat.
claims.quote: Users who are assigned the Global administrator role also have access to the Agent Dashboard.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Viva Insights analysts with global partition access have automatic Agent Dashboard access.
claims.quote: The following types of users also have automatic access to the Agent Dashboard: Viva Insights Analysts with global partition access

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Delegates have dashboard access through delegation.
claims.quote: The following types of users also have automatic access to the Agent Dashboard: ... Users with delegate access

claims.claim: Enabled managers with existing team-level Copilot Analytics access can access the dashboard.
claims.quote: Enabled managers who already have team-level access to Copilot Analytics in Viva Insights can also access the dashboard.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Automatic-access criteria are re-evaluated weekly.
claims.quote: The criteria above are analyzed on a weekly basis to capture any major organization changes. Each week, any new users who meet the above criteria gain access to the dashboard.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: In PIM-enabled tenants, Global administrators might lack access and can be added explicitly.
claims.quote: If you're a Privileged Identity Management (PIM) enabled tenant, global admins might not have access to the Agent Dashboard. If you want to give global admins access to the Agent Dashboard, add them explicitly

claims.claim: Dashboard data represents the previous 28 days.
claims.quote: Data in the dashboard represents data over the previous 28 days.

claims.claim: The views cover adoption metrics aggregated at user level.
claims.quote: Both views cover adoption metrics aggregated at the user level

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Agent names and group metrics are hidden for groups below the minimum group size.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, agent names and group metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The documented default minimum group size is 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The documented minimum-group-size setting has a floor of five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: Without an exclusion list, dashboard insights include employees with a Copilot licence, a Viva Insights licence or a cohort upload.
claims.quote: If you don't create an exclusion list, all employees who either have a Copilot license, a Viva Insights license, or are uploaded manually using the Cohort upload feature in the admin center, are included in dashboard insights

claims.claim: Learn describes reporting, not actions that this dashboard takes on agents.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent Dashboard" manage agents actions reporting adoption. Read the full Agent Dashboard page, including Key actions users can take in the report: View by and Filters. No dashboard operation that changes agents is described.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard licence table includes Agent Dashboard for 50 assigned Viva Insights licences or at least 50 assigned Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Tenants with at least 50 Copilot licenses or at least 50 Viva Insights licenses also have access to agent-related insights

claims.claim: The planned licence removal is classified as included within the existing licensed dashboard product, not as a new separate purchase.
claims.quote: 50 or more | N/A | All features included: ... Agent-related insights including Agent Dashboard

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page publishes no separate price or meter for viewing the Agent 365 Dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" price meter cost billing. Read the full Agent Dashboard page and the Copilot Dashboard licence table; neither publishes a separate price or meter for the view. Search results about costs of agents do not price viewing this dashboard.

claims.claim: Learn says the dashboard is unavailable in national/regional clouds, including US Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard isn't currently available for national/regional cloud deployments including but not limited to Microsoft's U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.

claims.claim: The analysed population includes all employees who have had agent activity.
claims.quote: The analyzed population in the Agent Dashboard includes all employees who have had agent activity.

claims.claim: Learn ties Agent 365 reporting history to acceptance of the Agent 365 licensing terms of use.
claims.quote: Its reporting history covers the period after which your organization accepted the terms of use of Agent 365 licensing.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published how that history rule works when Agent 365 licensing is not held under the planned change.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" "licensing" "terms" reporting history no license. Read Agent Dashboard and the Business Analytics Agents-page search excerpt; both retain the terms-acceptance rule and neither explains history under the planned waiver.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.
claims.fix: Insert the documented page name so the path reads: Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy. Apply the same change to the rendered table.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with VivaInsights, AgentDashboard, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide dashboard-disable policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : AgentDashboard
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the documented role for managing dashboard and web-app access.
claims.quote:
Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups
Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: The dashboard and web-app feature access controls support tenant, group and user scope.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level using the Agent Dashboard VFAM control in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Turning off the Agent Dashboard feature access control disables that dashboard.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the Agent Dashboard.

claims.claim: The printed web-app access path reaches Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.fix: The path stops on the right access-management page. For adding access, extend it to: Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add. In the note, say: "Use Groups instead of Users for groups; to revoke access, select existing users or groups and choose Remove selected users or Remove selected groups. Changes take effect in 24 hours." Apply the same correction to the rendered table.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with FeatureId "Viva Insights web app", IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide web-app-disable policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: Adding or removing web-app users takes effect in 24 hours.
claims.quote: When you add or remove users to the Viva Insights web app, the change will go into effect in 24 hours.

claims.claim: Disabling the web-app control disables the entire app, including Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and advanced analysis.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: Both the web-app control and Agent Dashboard control must be enabled to access the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can manage all the documented settings.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator role does not itself grant automatic web-app access.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app.

claims.claim: An AI Administrator must add themselves through the access process to gain web-app access.
claims.quote: To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.

claims.claim: VFAM can control whether the Agent 365 view reports non-public agents.
claims.quote: You can also use VFAM to set whether reporting in the Agent 365 Dashboard view includes non-public agents, or only agents available to all users in the organization.

claims.claim: The non-public-agent reporting control is identified as Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility.
claims.quote: FeatureId : Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility

claims.claim: Non-public agents include the Your org and User creator types.
claims.quote: Non-public agents include agents with a creator type of Your org or user, and might not be available to all users in your organization.

claims.claim: By default the Agent 365 Dashboard includes all agents rather than filtering out non-public agents.
claims.quote: By default, the Agent 365 Dashboard includes all agents.
